title: Native Linux build and release qualification alongside Windows

reuse.justification: Reused and extended Core's native UCRT/ELF build policy, standalone platform adapter matrix, GAWD repository gate checks, and xtask trusted-sysroot compiler bindings rather than introducing external cross-compilation wrappers.
